subject: SahajLipi full English Gregorian month word aliases in Nepali mode
accessScope: Public official Unicode sources: complete pinned JSON, package metadata, README and license downloaded and parsed. Official release/status/LDML pages and government HTML excerpts read on 2026-09-27.

primarySource.releaseStatus: Stable tagged JSON package patch release 48.2.1 (2026-07-08), following stable CLDR 48.2 (2026-03-17); patch release addresses updated time-zone rules, according to its release note.
primarySource.newerDevelopmentStatus: CLDR 49 beta announced 2026-09-25; not used for selected month outputs.
primarySource.generationStatus: JSON is generated from official XML using CLDR tooling; pinned README says included data meet contributed or approved draft threshold. This does not establish independent human review for the project.
primarySource.xmlCrossCheckScope: Gregorian format wide nodes 1 through 12 observed in official release-48-2 XML; raw standalone wide nodes use inheritance markers. Resolved standalone spellings verified in the pinned JSON.

contextComparison.interpretation: CLDR format is used within complete date patterns; stand-alone is for independent date elements such as calendar headers and can reflect different grammatical forms in some languages. Nepali wide values are identical for all twelve in this pinned release.
contextComparison.ordinalAndGenderScope: No ordinal/gender variants are encoded in these twelve selected month values. Do not infer ordinal rules or gender forms from this month table.

scopeLimitations: Selected outputs are a sourced project default; this evidence does not establish a uniquely universal Nepali orthography.
No independent human language review was performed.
Gregorian month names only; no Bikram Sambat date conversion or Bikram Sambat month substitution.
Twelve full English word aliases only; no abbreviated input aliases.
English title-case handling and explicit September/December exceptions to reserved Shift keys are SahajLipi implementation choices.
